actual_coordinate_definition: coordinates + lift + fluctuation; binary64 millimetres; scale one

boundary_intersections.intersection_semantics: Crossing or raw zero-distance touch/overlap; positive roundoff near-touch is separate

regions.projection_gap_definition: max(minA,minB)-min(maxA,maxB) on each unit edge-normal; mm; not penetration depth
regions.boundary_scope: Topologically exposed closed-region edges including any symmetry cut; self-overlap not tested; not physical contact boundaries

bottom.method: Analytic finite tangential-strip and forward-halfplane clipping; no dense sampling
bottom.scope: Directional boundary-hit diagnostic; not signed penetration or contact pressure

left.method: Analytic finite tangential-strip and forward-halfplane clipping; no dense sampling
left.scope: Directional boundary-hit diagnostic; not signed penetration or contact pressure

symmetry_cut_scope: Included for closed region classification; excluded from physical face-ray edges
